entities.summary: Eva Sybille Haule-Frimpong is a German former terrorist associated with the third generation Red Army Faction (RAF). She took her abitur in Stuttgart before going underground in 1984. Eva Haule was a painters & sculptors from Tübingen (b. 1954-07-16, Tübingen). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
